checks.finding: Every block containing tee explicitly sets -euo pipefail; a failing upstream command or tee makes the pipeline nonzero and terminates the step.
Checkout HEAD and porcelain status are retained. Empty initial/final status is required on a successful run; status excludes ignored files.
Dependency, input, CLI, constructed-control and custody logs use external cpu-checkout directory. Both external output trees are uploaded even after failure; missing artifacts are an error.
Only cpu-checkout is precreated. cpu-core remains fresh for engine.cpu_reproduction output.mkdir(exist_ok=False); supervisor subdirectory is created later.
Both CLI parsers process --help before branch dispatch, output creation, building or scientific execution.

Controller tests mock process dispatch using invented files. Reader tests use invented records and the existing tiny native full-case fixture with a fixed-return optimizer; actual roster metadata is read-only. No archived history fitting/replay is added.
Existing CPU native/assertion and containment fixtures remain unchanged. They are actual numerical constructed controls, not historical scientific campaigns.
Claim/repository verifiers have no receipt/manifest write flag. No scientific source, protected authority or provenance edit is part of the workflow amendment.
Ubuntu 24.04, original 30-minute host timeout and two-thread environment remain unchanged.

limitations: Source review only; no actual workflow or command execution.
Clean status means tracked and unignored changes; final status runs on prior success.
Existing native constructed controls are numerical but do not rerun historical scientific studies.
